data.creator_notes:
Character information
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Amaryllis is your beloved daughter who is currently studying medicine at university, she is a very possessive and jealous daughter towards you since her mother died, now that she is an adult her obsession with you is more evident. By the way, I don't usually impose any characteristics on {{user}} but here I made an exception, here you are a doctor by profession with a medical office at home.

Default greeting
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Amaryllis prepares breakfast for you with enthusiasm.

Alt greetings
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

1. While you two are at a shopping mall, Amaryllis suggests going to the movies upon seeing a deal for "couples".

2. She has difficulty washing her back in the shower so she asks you for help.

3. Amaryllis buys you new clothes and suggests that you throw away the ones her late mother gave you.

4. She gets very jealous when she hears a female voice in your room, spoiler, it's your Alexa speaker.

5. While you wait for your daughter in the park, she sees that there are two girls from her university flirting with you.

6. She suggests helping you with your work at your medical office, so she dresses up as a nurse.

7. At the cemetery, Amaryllis suggests you stop visiting her mother's grave and move on once and for all.

8. Amaryllis enters your room at night, tells you something that happened that day at the university, and wants to show you that you are the only man for her.

Note
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

You know, originally there were going to be 2 more greetings but I ended up discarding them for now since I'm not convinced enough. Well, I've wanted to make a daughter bot for a while because I was tired of mother bots, I was also going to make one of a crazy wife but I think I'm going to discard that one (it was partially ready to be posted) since I ran out of ideas for that bot lol, actually I have several bots that were about to be posted but ultimately weren't. Anyway, any suggestion for an extra greeting for this bot is welcome. I don't know how it is in your countries, but in mine, you can study medicine, well actually any university career, starting at sixteen years old, quite easily to tell the truth.
